# 1. Initialize the project architecture

```{r initialize-architecture}
manifest_path <- "dev/course-manifest.csv"

stopifnot(
  file.exists("_quarto.yml"), 
  file.exists(manifest_path)
)

manifest <- read.csv(
  manifest_path,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA")
)

required_columns <- c(
  "module_number",
  "module_title",
  "module_folder",
  "page_order",
  "page_id",
  "page_type",
  "page_title",
  "file_name",
  "relative_path",
  "content_status"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(manifest))

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing manifest columns: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

manifest <- manifest[
  order(manifest$module_number, manifest$page_order),
]

if (anyDuplicated(manifest$relative_path)) {
  stop("The manifest contains duplicate relative paths.")
}

if (anyDuplicated(manifest$page_id)) {
  stop("The manifest contains duplicate page IDs.")
}

if (!all(startsWith(manifest$relative_path, "modules/"))) {
  stop("Every generated page must be inside modules/.")
}

if (!all(manifest$page_type %in%
         c("overview", "core", "readiness", "meeting_pack", "milestone"))) {
  stop("Unknown page type found in the manifest.")
}


# Helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------

yaml_string <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\\\\\", x)
  x <- gsub('"', '\\"', x, fixed = TRUE)
  paste0('"', x, '"')
}

placeholder_notice <- c(
  "::: {.callout-note}",
  "Ez az oldal a navigációs prototípus része. A végleges tartalom később kerül ide.",
  ":::"
)

module_page_list <- function(module_rows) {
  content_rows <- module_rows[module_rows$page_type != "overview", ]

  c(
    "## A modul oldalai",
    "",
    sprintf(
      "%d. [%s](%s)",
      seq_len(nrow(content_rows)),
      content_rows$page_title,
      content_rows$file_name
    )
  )
}

page_body <- function(row, module_rows) {
  module_label <- sprintf(
    "%d. modul — %s",
    row$module_number,
    row$module_title
  )

  if (row$page_type == "overview") {
    return(c(
      placeholder_notice,
      "",
      "## A modul célja",
      "",
      "[A modul rövid bemutatása később kerül ide.]",
      "",
      "## A modul mérföldköve",
      "",
      "[A meeting során elérendő projektmérföldkő leírása később kerül ide.]",
      "",
      module_page_list(module_rows)
    ))
  }

  if (row$page_type %in% c("core", "meeting_pack")) {
    return(c(
      sprintf("[%s](index.qmd)", paste0("← ", module_label)),
      "",
      placeholder_notice,
      "",
      "## Miről lesz szó?",
      "",
      "[Rövid bevezető helye.]",
      "",
      "## Tartalom",
      "",
      "[A végleges tananyag helye.]"
    ))
  }

  if (row$page_type == "readiness") {
    return(c(
      sprintf("[%s](index.qmd)", paste0("← ", module_label)),
      "",
      placeholder_notice,
      "",
      "## Önellenőrzés",
      "",
      "- [ ] Helykitöltő ellenőrzési pont."
    ))
  }

  if (row$page_type == "milestone") {
    return(c(
      sprintf("[%s](index.qmd)", paste0("← ", module_label)),
      "",
      placeholder_notice,
      "",
      "## A projektmérföldkő",
      "",
      "[A mérföldkő leírása később kerül ide.]",
      "",
      "## Mit jelent, hogy elértétek?",
      "",
      "[A rugalmas minimumkritériumok leírása később kerül ide.]"
    ))
  }

  stop("Unhandled page type: ", row$page_type)
}

write_page <- function(row, module_rows) {
  front_matter <- c(
    "---",
    paste0("title: ", yaml_string(row$page_title)),
    paste0(
      "subtitle: ",
      yaml_string(
        sprintf(
          "%d. modul — %s",
          row$module_number,
          row$module_title
        )
      )
    ),
    paste0("page-id: ", yaml_string(row$page_id)),
    paste0("page-type: ", yaml_string(row$page_type)),
    paste0("module-number: ", row$module_number),
    paste0("module-title: ", yaml_string(row$module_title)),
    paste0("page-order: ", row$page_order),
    paste0("content-status: ", yaml_string(row$content_status)),
    "toc: false",
    "---"
  )

  content <- c(
    front_matter,
    "",
    page_body(row, module_rows),
    ""
  )

  dir.create(
    dirname(row$relative_path),
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  writeLines(
    content,
    con = row$relative_path,
    useBytes = TRUE
  )
}


# Destructive rebuild ------------------------------------------------------

if (dir.exists("modules")) {
  unlink(
    "modules",
    recursive = TRUE,
    force = TRUE
  )
}

dir.create("modules")

for (module_number in sort(unique(manifest$module_number))) {
  module_rows <- manifest[
    manifest$module_number == module_number,
  ]

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(module_rows))) {
    write_page(
      row = module_rows[i, ],
      module_rows = module_rows
    )
  }
}


# Validation ---------------------------------------------------------------

missing_files <- manifest$relative_path[
  !file.exists(manifest$relative_path)
]

if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Some pages were not created:\n",
    paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

created_files <- list.files(
  "modules",
  pattern = "\\.qmd$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(created_files) != nrow(manifest)) {
  stop(
    "Expected ",
    nrow(manifest),
    " QMD files but found ",
    length(created_files),
    "."
  )
}

message(
  "Module skeleton created successfully: ",
  length(created_files),
  " pages in ",
  length(unique(manifest$module_number)),
  " modules."
)

print(
  with(
    manifest,
    table(module_number, page_type)
  )
)
```


# Cleanup old
```{r}
text_files <- list.files(
  ".",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE,
  all.files = TRUE,
  no.. = TRUE,
  pattern = "\\.(qmd|Rmd|R|yml|yaml|md|scss|html|txt)$"
)

relative_files <- sub("^\\./", "", text_files)

excluded <- grepl(
  "^(_site|\\.git|\\.quarto|_freeze|_includes|_templates)/",
  relative_files
) | relative_files == "work.txt"

text_files <- text_files[!excluded]
relative_files <- relative_files[!excluded]

obsolete_patterns <- c(
  "_includes/",
  "_templates/",
  "_cycle-route-script",
  "_learning-header",
  "_meeting-connection",
  "_route-problem-identification",
  "_workspace-action",
  "cycle-overview",
  "module-closing"
)

hits <- list()
hit_number <- 0L

for (i in seq_along(text_files)) {
  lines <- readLines(
    text_files[[i]],
    warn = FALSE,
    encoding = "UTF-8"
  )

  for (pattern in obsolete_patterns) {
    matched <- grep(
      pattern,
      lines,
      fixed = TRUE
    )

    if (length(matched) > 0) {
      hit_number <- hit_number + 1L

      hits[[hit_number]] <- data.frame(
        file = relative_files[[i]],
        line = matched,
        pattern = pattern,
        text = trimws(lines[matched]),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
}

if (length(hits) > 0) {
  hits <- do.call(rbind, hits)
  print(hits, row.names = FALSE)
  stop("Obsolete components are still referenced outside their own directories.")
}

message("No external references to the obsolete component system.")
```

## delete old
```{r}
obsolete_paths <- c(
  "_includes",
  "_templates",
  "assets/images/02-problem-identification",
  ".scupschool-pilot-v2-built",
  "work.txt"
)

existing_paths <- obsolete_paths[
  file.exists(obsolete_paths) |
    dir.exists(obsolete_paths)
]

for (path in existing_paths) {
  unlink(
    path,
    recursive = TRUE,
    force = TRUE
  )

  message("Deleted: ", path)
}
```

## vmi audit
```{r}
audit_roots <- c(
  "_quarto.yml",
  "index.qmd",
  "README.md",
  "_brand.yml",
  "_variables.yml",
  "dev",
  "modules",
  "assets/styles"
)

audit_files <- unlist(
  lapply(
    audit_roots,
    function(path) {
      if (dir.exists(path)) {
        list.files(
          path,
          recursive = TRUE,
          full.names = TRUE,
          pattern = "\\.(qmd|Rmd|R|yml|yaml|md|scss|csv)$"
        )
      } else if (file.exists(path)) {
        path
      } else {
        character()
      }
    }
  ),
  use.names = FALSE
)

obsolete_terms <- c(
  "tanulási ciklus",
  "learning cycle",
  "meeting-centred",
  "cycle-",
  "cycle_",
  "01-introduction",
  "02-brainstorming",
  "03-project-development",
  "04-pitch",
  "problem-identification",
  "meeting-connection",
  "workspace-action",
  "module-closing",
  "ScupSchool"
)

audit_hits <- list()
hit_number <- 0L

for (file in audit_files) {
  lines <- readLines(
    file,
    warn = FALSE,
    encoding = "UTF-8"
  )

  for (term in obsolete_terms) {
    matched <- grep(
      term,
      lines,
      fixed = TRUE
    )

    if (length(matched) > 0) {
      hit_number <- hit_number + 1L

      audit_hits[[hit_number]] <- data.frame(
        file = file,
        line = matched,
        term = term,
        text = trimws(lines[matched]),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
}

if (length(audit_hits) == 0) {
  message("No obsolete structural references found.")
} else {
  audit_hits <- do.call(rbind, audit_hits)
  print(audit_hits, row.names = FALSE)
}
```
